The Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association will be closed for regular facility maintenance at Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry on Saturday, June 6 and Sunday, June 7, 2026 (Reiwa 8). Information services, including phone support, will not be available on these dates. Eagle Bus regular ticket purchases and manhole card distribution will not be available. The Pratto Hanno information desk at Hanno Station (TEL 042-978-9111, 9:00–17:00) will remain open as usual.
